# App config

Source: https://dartondox.dev/latest/3.xreference/app-config/

# App config

Every field of `AppConfig`, with its type, its default and what it does.

`AppConfig` is the one object you give to `Dox().initialize()`. It lives in `lib/config/app.dart`.

Source: `packages/dox-core/lib/interfaces/app_config.dart`.

## Server

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appKey` | `String` | required | Encrypts cookies (`req.cookie()`, `DoxCookie`) and signs local storage URLs. In production the app stops at start when it is empty. Make one with `dox key:generate`. |
| `serverPort` | `int` | `3000` | The port the HTTP server listens on. When the env has no `APP_PORT` but has `PORT`, Dox listens on `PORT` instead (Cloud Run, Fly, Render and Heroku set it). |
| `host` | `String?` | `null`: `APP_HOST`, else all interfaces | The network interface to listen on, like `127.0.0.1`. `null` reads the env var `APP_HOST`. With neither, Dox listens on all interfaces, IPv6 and IPv4 (`::`). |
| `totalIsolate` | `int?` | `Platform.numberOfProcessors` | Isolates (threads) that serve HTTP, all on the same port. On Windows the native server runs on one isolate. |
| `compress` | `bool` | `false` | gzip responses (`HttpServer.autoCompress`). Rust gzips on its own thread, not on the isolate. It still costs CPU on every response. Let a proxy do it when you have one. |
| `maxBodySize` | `int` | `10 * 1024 * 1024` (10 MB) | Biggest JSON or urlencoded body in bytes. Bigger gets `413`. |
| `maxMultipartSize` | `int` | `100 * 1024 * 1024` (100 MB) | Biggest `multipart/form-data` body (file uploads) in bytes. Bigger gets `413`. |
| `bodyTimeout` | `Duration` | `Duration(seconds: 120)` | A client that sends no body bytes for this long gets `408`. A slow but steady upload is fine. Native server only. |
| `shutdownTimeout` | `Duration` | `Duration(seconds: 8)` | On `SIGTERM` or `SIGINT`, how long open requests may run before Dox closes them. Keep it below the kill timeout of your platform. See [Graceful shutdown](../digging-deeper/deployment.md#graceful-shutdown). |
| `trustedProxies` | `List<String>` | `[]` | IPs or CIDR ranges of reverse proxies. Only when the direct client is in this list does Dox read `X-Forwarded-For` for `req.ip()` and `X-Forwarded-Proto` for `req.scheme()`. `['*']` trusts any direct client, and takes the right-most `X-Forwarded-For` hop (the one the proxy added) as the client. |

## Routing and request handling

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `container` | `void Function(IocContainer)?` | `null` | Fills the container: `registerContainer` from `lib/container.g.dart`. Every isolate runs it. It also gives the routers, services and model binders. See [Dependency injection](../the-basic/dependency-injection.md). |
| `routers` | `List<Router>` | `[]` | Routers to register first, in this order. Every other `Router` class comes from `container`. |
| `globalMiddleware` | `List<dynamic>` | `[]` | Middleware that runs on every route. A function or an `IDoxMiddleware`. |
| `dtos` | `List<DtoSchema<Object>>` | `[]` | Every DTO of the app: `dtos` from `lib/dtos.g.dart`. Dox finds the DTO of a controller parameter and of `req.validate<T>()` with it. |
| `validationMessages` | `MessageResolver?` | `null` (English messages) | Messages for validation errors, for example in other languages. |
| `responseHandler` | `ResponseHandlerInterface?` | `null` | A class with `DoxResponse handle(DoxResponse res)`. It sees every response before it is sent. |
| `exceptionHandler` | `ExceptionHandler` | `ExceptionHandler()` | Reports every unhandled error and turns it into a response. The default logs the error with `Logger.warn` and the stack with `Logger.danger`. See [Error handling](../the-basic/errors.md). |
| `services` | `List<DoxService>` | `[]` | Services to run first, in this order. Every other `DoxService` class comes from `container`. Dox runs them in every isolate at start. |

## Sub configs

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cors` | `CORSConfig` | `CORSConfig()` | CORS headers. See [CORSConfig](#corsconfig). |
| `logger` | `LoggerConfig` | `LoggerConfig()` | The `Logger` output. See [LoggerConfig](#loggerconfig). |
| `cache` | `CacheConfig` | `file` store in `storage/cache`, plus a `memory` store | Cache stores for `Cache()`. See [CacheConfig](#cacheconfig). |
| `storage` | `StorageConfig` | `local` disk with root `storage` | Storage disks for `Storage()`. See [StorageConfig](#storageconfig). |
| `openApi` | `OpenApiConfig` | `OpenApiConfig()` | `/docs`, `/openapi.json` and `/openapi.yaml`. See [OpenApiConfig](#openapiconfig). |
| `socketIo` | `SocketIoConfig` | `SocketIoConfig()` (off) | Socket.IO on the HTTP port. See [SocketIoConfig](#socketioconfig). |

## CORSConfig

Source: `packages/dox-core/lib/interfaces/app_config.dart`. Headers are set in `packages/dox-core/lib/http/http_cors_handler.dart`.

A value can be a `String` (`'*'` or a comma list) or a `List<String>`. A `null` value sends no header.

| Field | Type | Default | Header |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `bool` | `true` | Send CORS headers. A route can override it with its own `cors` setting. |
| `origin` | `dynamic` | `null` | `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`. One origin, `'*'`, or a list. With a list, Dox sends back only the request origin if it is in the list. |
| `methods` | `dynamic` | `null` | `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` |
| `headers` | `dynamic` | `null` | `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` |
| `exposeHeaders` | `dynamic` | `null` | `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` |
| `credentials` | `bool?` | `null` | `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` |
| `maxAge` | `num?` | `null` | `Access-Control-Max-Age` in seconds |

!!! note
    With the default `CORSConfig()` every value is `null`. So `enabled: true` alone sends no header. Set `origin` at least.

## LoggerConfig

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `String` | `''` | The `name` field in each JSON log line. |
| `enabled` | `bool` | `false` | Turn the `Logger` on. |
| `prettyPrint` | `bool` | `false` | `true` prints colored text. `false` prints one JSON object per line (for log services). |
| `level` | `String` | `'info'` | The lowest level to print: `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`. `Logger.success` counts as `info`. `Logger.danger` counts as `error`. An unknown value prints every line. |

## CacheConfig

Source: `packages/dox-cache/lib/src/cache_config.dart`. Option keys: `packages/dox-cache/lib/src/constants/cache_constants.dart`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultStore` | `String` | required | The store `Cache()` uses when no store is named. |
| `stores` | `Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>>` | required | Store name to options. Each store needs a `driver` option. |

Options of each driver:

| Driver | Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| all | `driver` | `String` | required | `file`, `memory`, `redis` or `null` |
| all | `prefix` | `String` | `dox_cache:` | Text in front of every key. |
| `file` | `path` | `String` | `storage/cache` | Folder of the cache files. |
| `memory` | `max_size` | `int` | no limit | Most items in the map. |
| `redis` | `host` | `String` | `127.0.0.1` | Redis host. |
| `redis` | `port` | `int` | `6379` | Redis port. |
| `redis` | `username` | `String` | none | Redis user. |
| `redis` | `password` | `String` | none | Redis password. |
| `redis` | `db` | `int` | `0` | Redis database number. |
| `redis` | `tls` | `bool` | `false` | Use TLS. |
| `redis` | `pool_size` | `int` | `10` | Most connections per store. |

## StorageConfig

Source: `packages/dox-core/lib/storage/storage_config.dart`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultDisk` | `String` | `'local'` | The disk `Storage()` uses when no disk is named. |
| `disks` | `Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>>` | `{'local': {'driver': 'local', 'root': 'storage'}}` | Disk name to options. Each disk needs a `driver` option. |

Options of each driver:

| Driver | Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| all | `driver` | `String` | required | `local`, `s3` or `memory` |
| `local` | `root` | `String` | `storage` | Folder of the files. |
| `local` | `url` | `String` | none | Base of the public URLs, like `http://localhost:3000/files`. |
| `local` | `app_key` | `String` | `AppConfig.appKey` | Key that signs the URLs. |
| `local` | `visibility` | `String` | `public` | `public` or `private`. |
| `s3` | `bucket` | `String` | required | Bucket name. |
| `s3` | `region` | `String` | `us-east-1` | Region. |
| `s3` | `key` | `String` | required | Access key id. |
| `s3` | `secret` | `String` | required | Secret access key. |
| `s3` | `token` | `String` | none | Session token. |
| `s3` | `endpoint` | `String` | none | Custom endpoint (R2, MinIO, Spaces). |
| `s3` | `path_style` | `bool` | `false` | Use path style URLs. |
| `s3` | `url` | `String` | none | Base of the public URLs. |
| `s3` | `visibility` | `String` | `private` | `public` or `private`. |
| `s3` | `acl` | `bool` | `true` | The service supports ACLs. |
| `s3` | `batch_delete` | `bool` | `true` | The service supports batch delete. |

An unknown driver throws `ArgumentError('Storage disk "<name>" has unknown driver "<type>"')`.

## OpenApiConfig

Source: `packages/dox-core/lib/openapi/openapi_config.dart`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `bool?` | `null` | Serve the docs routes. `null` means: on only when `APP_ENV` is `development` or `local`. |
| `info` | `Info` | `Info(title: 'Dox API', version: '1.0.0')` | Title and version of the API. |
| `servers` | `List<Server>` | `[]` | Base URLs of the API. |
| `securitySchemes` | `Map<String, SecurityScheme>` | `{}` | Ways to log in, like `{'bearerAuth': SecurityScheme.bearer()}`. |
| `securityByMiddleware` | `Map<String, List<Map<String, List<String>>>>` | `{}` | Security for routes that use a middleware class with this name. `AuthMiddleware` gets `bearerAuth` when it is not in the map. |
| `registry` | `OpenApiRegistry` | `OpenApiRegistry()` (empty) | What `dox_builder` found in the code. Pass `openApiRegistry` from `lib/openapi.g.dart`. |
| `ui` | `DocsUi` | `DocsUi.scalar` | `scalar` or `swagger`. |
| `scalar` | `ScalarOptions` | `ScalarOptions()` | Options of the Scalar page. See below. |
| `pageTitle` | `String?` | `null` (uses `info.title`) | Title of the `/docs` page. |

`ScalarOptions` (`packages/dox-openapi/lib/src/docs_ui.dart`):

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | `ScalarTheme` | `ScalarTheme.default_` | One of `default_`, `alternate`, `moon`, `purple`, `solarized`, `bluePlanet`, `deepSpace`, `saturn`, `kepler`, `elysiajs`, `fastify`, `mars`, `laserwave`, `none`. |
| `darkMode` | `bool` | `false` | Start in dark mode. |
| `showDownloadButton` | `bool` | `true` | Show the download button for the OpenAPI document. |
| `proxyUrl` | `String?` | `null` | Send "Try it" requests through this proxy. |

## SocketIoConfig

Source: `packages/dox-core/lib/socketio/socket_io_config.dart`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `bool` | `false` | Mount Socket.IO on the HTTP port at `/socket.io/`. |
| `options` | `ServerOptions` | `ServerOptions()` | Engine options. See below. |
| `namespaces` | `List<NamespaceHandler>` | `[]` | Namespaces to register, like `ChatNamespace()`. |
| `adapter` | `SocketAdapterFactory?` | `null` (in memory) | Makes the adapter in each isolate. Use a Redis adapter with many isolates. |

`ServerOptions` (`packages/dox-socketio/lib/src/engine/server_options.dart`). The defaults match the Node.js server.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `String` | `/socket.io/` | URL path. Must end with `/`. |
| `pingInterval` | `Duration` | 25 s | Time between two server pings. |
| `pingTimeout` | `Duration` | 20 s | Time to wait for a pong before the session is closed. |
| `upgradeTimeout` | `Duration` | 10 s | Time a websocket upgrade may take. |
| `connectTimeout` | `Duration` | 45 s | Time a client has to join a namespace after the handshake. |
| `maxHttpBufferSize` | `int` | `1000000` | Biggest message in bytes a client may send. |
| `transports` | `List<String>` | `['polling', 'websocket']` | Allowed transports. |
| `allowUpgrades` | `bool` | `true` | Allow upgrades from polling to websocket. |
| `cors` | `CorsOptions?` | `null` (no CORS headers) | CORS for the long-polling requests. |

`CorsOptions`:

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `origins` | `List<String>` | `['*']` | Allowed origins. |
| `credentials` | `bool` | `false` | Send `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`. |
| `methods` | `List<String>` | `['GET', 'POST']` | Allowed methods for preflight. |
| `allowedHeaders` | `List<String>?` | `null` (the requested headers) | Allowed request headers. |
| `maxAge` | `Duration?` | `null` | How long a browser may cache the preflight answer. |

## DatabaseConfig

The database is not a field of `AppConfig`. A service calls `SqlQueryBuilder.initializeWithDatabaseConfig(databaseConfig)` in its `setup()`.
Source: `packages/dox-orm/lib/src/types/database_config.dart` and `connection_config.dart`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `String` | required | Name of the connection to use. A missing name throws `Exception('<name> not found')`. |
| `connections` | `Map<String, ConnectionConfig>` | required | Connection name to config. |

`ConnectionConfig`:

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `driver` | `Driver` | required | `Driver.postgres`, `Driver.mysql` (also MariaDB) or `Driver.sqlite`. |
| `host` | `String` | `'localhost'` | Database host. Not used by sqlite. |
| `port` | `int` | `0` | Database port. Not used by sqlite. |
| `user` | `String` | `''` | Database user. Not used by sqlite. |
| `password` | `String` | `''` | Database password. Not used by sqlite. |
| `database` | `String` | required | Database name. For sqlite: the file path, or `:memory:`. |
| `useSSL` | `bool` | `false` | Use TLS. Postgres: mode `require` (no certificate check), set `extra['sslMode']` to change it. MySQL: the certificate is checked. |
| `debug` | `bool` | required | Print every query with `printer`. |
| `printer` | `QueryPrinter?` | `null` | `ConsoleQueryPrinter()`, `PrettyQueryPrinter()`, `FileQueryPrinter()` or your own. |
| `extra` | `Map<String, dynamic>` | `{}` | Driver options. See below. |
| `driverFactory` | `DBDriver Function(ConnectionConfig)?` | `null` | Your own driver class. It wins over every other setting. |

Keys of `extra`:

| Driver | Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| postgres, mysql | `maxConnectionCount` | `int` | `10` | Most open connections, for the whole process. |
| postgres, mysql | `threads` | `int` | `1` | Rust threads of the native driver. Only the first pool sets it. |
| mysql, sqlite | `preparedStatementCacheSize` | `int` | `100` | Prepared statements kept per connection. |
| postgres | `sslMode` | `String` | `require` with `useSSL`, else `disable` | TLS mode: `disable`, `prefer`, `require` or `verify-full`. |
| postgres | `sslRootCert` | `String` | none | Path of a PEM file with the CA certificates to trust for `verify-full`. `sslrootcert` in `DATABASE_URL`. |
| postgres | `timeZone` | `String` | `UTC` | Session time zone. |
| postgres | `applicationName` | `String` | none | Name of the app in `pg_stat_activity`. |
| mysql | `verifyCertificate` | `bool` | `true` | `false` skips the TLS certificate check. Only for a self-signed certificate in development. |
| mysql | `maxConnectionAge` | `Duration` | 12 hours | Close and reopen a connection after this time. |
| sqlite | `busyTimeout` | `int` | `5000` | `PRAGMA busy_timeout` in milliseconds. |

## AuthConfig

Auth is not a field of `AppConfig`. A service calls `Auth.initialize(AuthConfig(...))` in its `setup()`.
Source: `packages/dox-auth/lib/src/interfaces.dart`.

| Class | Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AuthConfig` | `defaultGuard` | `String` | required | The guard `Auth()` uses when no guard is named. |
| `AuthConfig` | `guards` | `Map<String, AuthGuard>` | `{}` | Guard name to guard. |
| `AuthGuard` | `driver` | `AuthDriver` | required | How a token is made and checked, like `JwtAuthDriver(secret: SecretKey(...))`. |
| `AuthGuard` | `provider` | `AuthProvider` | required | Where users come from. |
| `AuthProvider` | `model` | `dynamic Function()` | required | Makes the user model, like `() => User()`. |
| `AuthProvider` | `identifierFields` | `List<String>` | `['email']` | Columns `attempt()` matches the login with. |
| `AuthProvider` | `passwordField` | `String` | `'password'` | Column with the bcrypt hash. |

## Full example

The config files of a new project. They read their values from `env`, the typed env class in `lib/config/env.dart` (see [Env reference](env.md)).

```dart title="lib/config/app.dart"
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:dox_core/dox_core.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/cache.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/cors.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/logger.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/storage.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/env.dart';
import 'package:my_app/container.g.dart';

AppConfig appConfig = AppConfig(
  /// Changing the key makes old cookies and encrypted data unreadable.
  appKey: env.appKey,
  serverPort: env.appPort,
  totalIsolate: env.appTotalIsolate ?? Platform.numberOfProcessors,
  globalMiddleware: <dynamic>[
    LogMiddleware(enabled: env.appEnv != 'production'),
  ],
  container: registerContainer,
  cache: cache,
  storage: storage,
  cors: cors,
  logger: logger,
);
```

```dart title="lib/config/cache.dart"
import 'package:dox_core/dox_core.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/env.dart';

CacheConfig cache = CacheConfig(
  defaultStore: env.cacheStore,
  stores: <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
    'file': <String, dynamic>{'driver': 'file', 'path': 'storage/cache'},

    /// one map per isolate, fast, not shared
    'memory': <String, dynamic>{'driver': 'memory', 'max_size': 10000},
  },
);
```

```dart title="lib/config/storage.dart"
import 'package:dox_core/dox_core.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/env.dart';

StorageConfig storage = StorageConfig(
  defaultDisk: env.storageDisk,
  disks: <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
    'local': <String, dynamic>{'driver': 'local', 'root': 'storage'},
  },
);
```

```dart title="lib/config/logger.dart"
import 'package:dox_core/dox_core.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/env.dart';

LoggerConfig logger = LoggerConfig(
  name: env.appName,
  enabled: true,
  level: env.logLevel,
  /// colored text is slow. JSON lines in production.
  prettyPrint: env.isDevelopment,
);
```

```dart title="lib/config/database.dart"
import 'package:dox_orm/dox_orm.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/env.dart';

/// Print every SQL query only in development.
bool _debug = env.isDevelopment;

DatabaseConfig databaseConfig = DatabaseConfig(
  connection: env.dbConnection,
  connections: <String, ConnectionConfig>{
    'postgres': ConnectionConfig(
      driver: Driver.postgres,
      host: env.dbHost,
      port: env.dbPort ?? 5432,
      user: env.dbUsername,
      password: env.dbPassword,
      database: env.dbName,
      extra: <String, dynamic>{
        /// One pool for all isolates.
        'maxConnectionCount': 10,
        'maxConnectionAge': Duration(hours: 1),
      },
      debug: _debug,
      printer: PrettyQueryPrinter(),
    ),

    /// MySQL and MariaDB
    'mysql': ConnectionConfig(
      driver: Driver.mysql,
      host: env.dbHost,
      port: env.dbPort ?? 3306,
      user: env.dbUsername,
      password: env.dbPassword,
      database: env.dbName,
      extra: <String, dynamic>{'collation': 'utf8mb4_general_ci'},
      debug: _debug,
      printer: PrettyQueryPrinter(),
    ),

    /// `DB_NAME` is a file path, or `:memory:`.
    'sqlite': ConnectionConfig(
      driver: Driver.sqlite,
      database: env.dbName,
      debug: _debug,
      printer: PrettyQueryPrinter(),
    ),
  },
);
```

```dart title="lib/config/cors.dart"
import 'package:dox_core/dox_core.dart';

CORSConfig cors = CORSConfig(
  enabled: false,
  origin: '*',
  methods: '*',
  headers: '*',
  exposeHeaders: <String>[
    'cache-control',
    'content-language',
    'content-type',
    'expires',
    'last-modified',
    'pragma',
  ],
  credentials: true,
  maxAge: 90,
);
```

```dart title="lib/services/orm_service.dart"
import 'package:dox_core/dox_core.dart';
import 'package:dox_orm/dox_orm.dart';
import 'package:my_app/config/database.dart';

/// Dox finds it by itself and runs it in every isolate.
/// No database? Delete this file.
class ORMService implements DoxService, DoxShutdown {
  @override
  Future<void> setup() async {
    SqlQueryBuilder.initializeWithDatabaseConfig(databaseConfig);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> shutdown() async {
    await SqlQueryBuilder.close();
  }
}
```

A new project has no `openapi.dart`, `socketio.dart` or auth service. You add them when you need them. See [OpenAPI](../packages/openapi.md), [Socket.IO](../packages/socketio.md) and [Authentication](../security/authentication.md).


---

# CLI

Source: https://dartondox.dev/latest/3.xreference/cli/

# CLI

Every `dox` command, with its options and the files it writes.

The commands come from `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/command_registry.dart`. The file templates are Dart strings inside `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/`. The path of each template is given below.

How to install the CLI is on the [Dox CLI](../digging-deeper/dox-cli.md) page.

Rules that apply to every command:

- `dox` with no command prints `Could not find a command. Run `dox help` for more information.`
- An unknown command prints `Could not find a command named "<name>".`
- Too few or too many arguments prints `Invalid number of arguments for command "<name>".` with the expected count.
- A name you pass is turned into `snake_case` for the file and `PascalCase` for the class. `BlogPost` and `blog_post` give the same result.
- A `create:*` command does not overwrite. When the file exists it prints `<name> already exists` and stops.

## Project

### `dox create`

```
dox create <project_name> [--version <version>]
```

Makes a new project from the [dox-sample](https://github.com/dartondox/dox-sample) repo.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--version <v>` (or `--v`) | The release tag to clone, like `3.0.0-alpha.5` or `v3.0.0-alpha.5`. Without it, the newest `dox-sample` release with the same major version as the CLI is used (pre-releases included). |

What it does:

1. Turns the name into `snake_case`. Stops with `Folder name "<name>" already exist` when the folder is there.
2. Picks the release (see `--version` above) from the release list of `dartondox/dox-sample`.
3. Runs `git clone --depth 1 --branch v<version> https://github.com/dartondox/dox-sample.git <name>`.
4. Deletes the `.git` folder.
5. Replaces `dox_sample` with your project name in every file, except files under `bin/dox`.
6. Copies `.env.example` to `.env` and writes a new random `APP_KEY` to it, like `dox key:generate`. It skips this step when `.env` is already there.

Needs `curl` and `git` on the `PATH`.

Source: `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_project.dart`.

### `dox serve`

```
dox serve [--ignore-build-runner]
dox s
dox server
```

Starts the dev server.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--ignore-build-runner` | Do not start `dart run build_runner watch`. |

What it does:

1. Starts `dart run build_runner watch` (unless the option is set).
2. Starts `dart run bin/server.dart` and prints its output.
3. Watches the project folder. When a `.dart` file changes it prints `[Dox] File changed: <file>`, waits 500 ms, kills the server and starts it again.

Source: `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/server_serve.dart`.

### `dox build`

```
dox build
```

AOT compiles the app for production into `build/bundle`. Use this in production, not `dart run`.

What it does:

1. When `pubspec.yaml` contains `build_runner`: runs `dart run build_runner build`. Stops with exit code 1 when it fails.
2. Runs `dart build cli --target bin/server.dart --output build`.
3. Copies `db/` to `build/bundle/db` (migrations are read at start).
4. Copies `.env.example` to `build/bundle/.env.example`.
5. Prints `[Dox] Built build/bundle. Run it with: cd build/bundle && ./bin/server`.

Output:

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `build/bundle/bin/server` | the native binary, no Dart SDK needed |
| `build/bundle/lib/` | native libraries from build hooks (SQLite, `dox_http_native`, ...) |
| `build/bundle/db/` | your migrations |
| `build/bundle/.env.example` | copy it to `.env` or set real env vars |

`dart compile exe` can not build packages with build hooks, so the CLI uses `dart build cli`.

Source: `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/server_serve.dart` (`buildServer`).

### `dox build_runner:build` and `dox build_runner:watch`

```
dox build_runner:build
dox build_runner:watch
```

Run `dart run build_runner build` once, or `dart run build_runner watch`. No options.
The CLI does not pass `--delete-conflicting-outputs` (build_runner removed that flag).

### `dox key:generate`

```
dox key:generate
```

Makes a 32 character key (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, from `Random.secure()`) and writes it to `APP_KEY` in `.env`.
Prints `<key> : Key have been updated successfully in .env!`.

What it does with `.env`:

- Reads `.env` in the current folder. The file must exist, else the command fails with a file error.
- Replaces the value of `APP_KEY`. Every other line stays as it is, in the same order. This keeps comments, blank lines, quotes and values with more than one `=` (like `DATABASE_URL=postgres://u:p@h/db?a=b`).
- Adds `APP_KEY=<key>` as the first line when there is no `APP_KEY`.

Source: `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/generate_key.dart`.

### `dox env:generate`

```
dox env:generate
```

Writes `lib/config/env.dart`, the typed env class, from `.env.example`.

- Stops with `.env.example is missing.` (exit code 1) when there is no example file.
- Stops with `lib/config/env.dart is already there. Delete it to make it again.` (exit code 1) when the file exists.
- Prints `Run `dart run build_runner build` to make env.g.dart.` when done.

Rules for each key: digits give `int get x => <value>;`, `true`/`false` give `bool`, an empty value gives `String? get x;`, any other value gives `String get x;` (required, no default). `#` comment lines above a key become its doc comment. A key that does not map back from `camelCase` gets `@EnvKey('KEY')`.

Source: `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/env_tools.dart` (`EnvScaffold`).

### `dox env:check`

```
dox env:check
```

Loads `AppEnv` from `lib/config/env.dart` with the real environment and `.env`. Prints `The env is valid.` or an `EnvException` with every missing or bad key (exit code 1).

It writes a small script to `.dart_tool/dox/env_check.dart` and runs it with `dart run`. It needs `lib/config/env.dart` and a `name:` in `pubspec.yaml`.

Source: `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/env_tools.dart` (`envCheck`).

### `dox openapi:generate`

```
dox openapi:generate [dir]
```

Runs `dart run bin/openapi.dart [dir]`. That file writes `openapi.json` and `openapi.yaml` into `dir` (default `storage/openapi`).
Stops with `bin/openapi.dart is missing.` (exit code 1) when the file is not there. See [OpenAPI](../packages/openapi.md).

Source: `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/openapi_generate.dart`.

### `dox update`

```
dox update
```

Installs the newest CLI with the same major version as the one you have. Pre-releases count.
It reads the version list from pub.dev, then runs `dart pub global activate dox <version>`.

Source: `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/update_dox.dart`.

### `dox version`

```
dox version
dox v
dox -v
dox --version
```

Prints `Dox version: <version>`. Aliases: `--version`, `-version`, `v`, `-v`, `--v`.

### `dox help`

```
dox help [command]
```

Without a command: lists every command by category. With a command: prints its usage, description, category, aliases and argument count.

## Create files

### `dox create:controller`

```
dox create:controller <name> [-r]
```

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-r` | A resource controller with `index`, `create`, `store`, `show`, `edit`, `update`, `destroy`. |

A trailing `Controller` in the name is removed: `UserController` and `User` give the same file.

| Form | Writes | Template |
| --- | --- | --- |
| plain | `lib/app/http/controllers/<name>.controller.dart` | `_getSample` in `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_controller.dart` |
| `-r` | `lib/app/http/controllers/<name>.controller.dart` | `_getResourceSample` in the same file |

The class has `@Inject()`, so the container makes it. A comment shows the route to add, like `Route.get<BlogController>('path', (BlogController c) => c.index);`.
After the file is made, the CLI tells you to run `dart run build_runner build`. That adds the controller to `lib/container.g.dart`.

### `dox create:middleware`

```
dox create:middleware <name>
```

Writes `lib/app/http/middleware/<name>.middleware.dart`: a class `<Name>Middleware extends IDoxMiddleware` with a `handle(IDoxRequest req)` that returns `req`.
A trailing `Middleware` in the name is removed.

Template: `_getSample` in `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_middleware.dart`.

### `dox create:dto`

```
dox create:dto <name>
```

Writes `lib/app/http/dtos/<name>.dto.dart`: a `@Dto()` class with one `name` field and `part '<name>.dto.g.dart';`.
A trailing `Dto` in the name is removed. Prints `Run `dox build_runner:build` to make <name>.dto.g.dart.`

Template: `_getSample` in `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_dto.dart`.

### `dox create:serializer`

```
dox create:serializer <name>
```

Writes `lib/app/http/serializers/<name>.serializer.dart`: a class `<Name>Serializer extends Serializer<<Name>>`. It imports the model from `lib/app/models/<name>/<name>.model.dart`.
A trailing `Serializer` in the name is removed.

Template: `_getSample` in `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_serializer.dart`.

### `dox create:model`

```
dox create:model <name> [-m|--migration]
dox make:model <name> [-m|--migration]
```

Writes `lib/app/models/<name>/<name>.model.dart`: a `@DoxModel()` class with `part '<name>.model.g.dart';`.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-m` or `--migration` | Also make a `create_<table>_table` migration. The table is the plural snake name: `BlogPost` gives `blog_posts`. The model then gets `@DoxModel(table: 'blog_posts')`. |

Any other second argument prints `Invalid option <x>, use -m or --migration` (exit code 1).

Template: `_getSample` in `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_model.dart`.

### `dox make:migration`

```
dox make:migration <name> [--sql]
dox create:migration <name> [--sql]
```

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--sql` | Make a `.sql` file with `-- up` and `-- down` sections instead of a Dart class. |

Writes `db/migration/<yyyy>_<mm>_<dd>_<hhmmss>_<name>.dart` (or `.sql`). Characters that are not letters, digits or `_` are removed from the name.

For a Dart migration it also:

- writes `db/migration/migrations.dart`, the registry of every Dart migration in the folder, sorted by name;
- writes `bin/migrate.dart` when it is missing, and prints `bin/migrate.dart created.`

The Dart template depends on the name:

| Name | `up()` | `down()` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `create_<table>_table` | `schema.create('<table>', ...)` with `id()` and `timestamps()` | `schema.dropIfExists('<table>')` |
| `<x>_to_<table>_table` (also `from`, `in`, `on`) | `schema.table('<table>', ...)` | `schema.table('<table>', ...)` |
| anything else | a comment | a comment |

Templates: `dartMigrationSource`, `migrateEntrySource` and `_sampleSql` in `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_migration.dart`.

## Migrations

All `migration:*` commands work the same way:

1. When `bin/migrate.dart` exists: write the registry again, then run `dart run bin/migrate.dart <command> [args]`. Your app code runs, so Dart migrations work.
2. When there is no `bin/migrate.dart` but `db/migration` has Dart files: print `db/migration has Dart migrations, but bin/migrate.dart is missing.` (exit code 1).
3. Else: run the `.sql` migrations with `Migrator()` from `dox_migration` in the CLI process.

The database comes from `DB_CONNECTION`, `DB_HOST`, `DB_PORT`, `DB_USERNAME`, `DB_PASSWORD` and `DB_DATABASE` (or `DB_NAME`). See [Environment variables](env.md).
A failed run prints the error and sets exit code 1.

| Command | Aliases | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dox migration:run` | `dox migrate` | Run the migrations that did not run yet. |
| `dox migration:rollback [--step=<count>]` | `dox migrate:rollback` | Undo the last batch, or the last `<count>` migrations. Any other option prints `Invalid option <x>, use --step=<count>` (exit code 1). |
| `dox migration:reset` | `dox migrate:reset` | Undo every migration. |
| `dox migration:refresh` | `dox migrate:refresh` | Undo every migration, then run them all again. |
| `dox migration:fresh` | `dox migrate:fresh` | Drop every table, then run all migrations. |
| `dox migration:status` | `dox migrate:status` | Print which migrations ran, and their batch. |

`--seed` after `migration:run`, `migration:refresh` or `migration:fresh` runs `dox db:seed` when the migrations end well.

## Factories and seeders

| Command | Aliases | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dox make:factory <model>` | `dox create:factory` | Make `db/factories/<model>.factory.dart`. It imports the model with the package name of `pubspec.yaml`. |
| `dox make:seeder <name>` | `dox create:seeder` | Make `db/seeders/<name>.seeder.dart`. It writes `db/seeders/seeders.dart` again, and makes `bin/seed.dart` when it is missing. |
| `dox db:seed [--class=<name>]` | | Write `db/seeders/seeders.dart` again, then run `dart run bin/seed.dart`. Default seeder: `DatabaseSeeder`. |

Templates: `createFactory` in `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_factory.dart`, and `createSeeder` and `seedEntrySource` in `packages/dox-cli/lib/src/tools/create_seeder.dart`.

# Environment variables

Source: https://dartondox.dev/latest/3.xreference/env/

# Environment variables

Every env var the framework and its packages read.

How to read your own keys with the typed env class is on the [Environment Variables](../digging-deeper/env.md) page.

The code reads env vars in three ways:

- `Env.get()` and `EnvReader` (`dox_core`): a real environment variable wins over the `.env` file.
- `Platform.environment` straight: only the real environment, `.env` is not read.
- `dox_migration` has its own `loadEnv()`: it reads `.env` and the real environment. A real environment variable wins, the same as `Env.get()`.

## Read by the framework

| Variable | Who reads it | Default | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APP_ENV` | `dox_core` (`Dox().checkAppKey()`, `OpenApiConfig.isEnabled`) | empty | Any value except `development`, `local` or `test` (also empty) makes a bad `APP_KEY` a startup error: missing, not exactly 32 characters, or a public sample key. In `development`, `local` and `test` it is only a warning. `development` or `local` turn the `/docs` routes on when `openApi.enabled` is `null`. Read with `Env.get`. | `APP_ENV=production` |
| `PORT` | `dox_core` (`DoxServer.portFor()`) | not set | The port to listen on, when `APP_PORT` is not set. Cloud Run, Fly, Render and Heroku set it. `APP_PORT` wins when both are set. Read with `Env.get`. | `PORT=8080` |
| `APP_HOST` | `dox_core` (`DoxServer.hostFor()`) | not set (all interfaces, `::`) | The host to listen on. `127.0.0.1` keeps the app off the network, for an app behind a proxy on the same machine. `AppConfig.host` wins over it. Read with `Env.get`. | `APP_HOST=127.0.0.1` |
| `DOX_HTTP_THREAD` | `dox_http_native` (Rust, `shared_thread()`) | not set (one thread per isolate) | `shared` puts the servers of all isolates on one network thread. Off by default: on 2 cores it cut req/s by a quarter. Real environment only (`std::env::var`), not `.env`. | `DOX_HTTP_THREAD=shared` |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `dox_orm` (`DatabaseConfig.url`), `dox_migration` | not set | A database url. When it is set, it wins over `DB_CONNECTION` and the other `DB_*` keys. `dox_orm` reads it from the real environment only. See [Database url](../database/index.md#database_url). | `DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:secret@db:5432/blog?sslmode=require` |
| `DB_CONNECTION` | `dox_migration` (`DbConnection.config()`) | postgres | `postgres`, `mysql` or `sqlite`. Any other value means postgres. | `DB_CONNECTION=sqlite` |
| `DB_HOST` | `dox_migration` | `localhost` | Database host. A path that starts with `/` is a Unix socket: the folder for Postgres, the socket file for MySQL. | `DB_HOST=127.0.0.1` |
| `DB_PORT` | `dox_migration` | `5432` (postgres), `3306` (mysql) | Database port. | `DB_PORT=5432` |
| `DB_USERNAME` | `dox_migration` | `postgres` (postgres), `root` (mysql) | Database user. | `DB_USERNAME=app` |
| `DB_PASSWORD` | `dox_migration` | `postgres` (postgres), empty (mysql) | Database password. | `DB_PASSWORD=secret` |
| `DB_DATABASE` | `dox_migration` | falls back to `DB_NAME`, then `dox` | Database name. For sqlite: the file path. | `DB_DATABASE=dox` |
| `DB_NAME` | `dox_migration` | `dox` | Same as `DB_DATABASE`. `DB_DATABASE` wins when both are set. | `DB_NAME=dox` |
| `HOME` / `USERPROFILE` | build hooks of `dox_http_native`, `dox_postgres_native`, `dox_mysql_native` | empty | Used to find `~/.cargo/bin/cargo` when the library must be built from source. | set by the OS |
| `DART_VM_OPTIONS` | the Dart VM | not set | Flags for the VM. The AOT binary from `dox build` reads it. Dox never sets VM flags for you. See [Performance](../digging-deeper/performance.md#dart-vm-flags). | `DART_VM_OPTIONS=--new_gen_semi_max_size=64` |

## Read by a new project

A new project (`dox create`) reads these keys through its typed env class, `lib/config/env.dart`. The framework itself does not read them. In code, use the getter: `env.appPort`.

| Variable | Getter | Type | Default | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APP_NAME` | `appName` | `String` | `dox` | `LoggerConfig.name`. |
| `APP_ENV` | `appEnv` | `String` | `development` | `development`, `staging` or `production`. `env.isDevelopment` is `true` for `development`. It turns on `prettyPrint` of the logger and the query log of the database. Also read by the framework (see above). |
| `APP_PORT` | `appPort` | `int` | `3000` | `AppConfig.serverPort`. When `APP_PORT` is not set, Dox listens on `PORT` if the env has it. |
| `APP_KEY` | `appKey` | `String` | required | `AppConfig.appKey`. It must be exactly 32 characters. Run `dox key:generate` for one. The app stops at start when it is missing, has another length, or is a public sample key (only a warning in `development`, `local` and `test`). |
| `APP_TOTAL_ISOLATE` | `appTotalIsolate` | `int?` | not set: one per CPU core | `AppConfig.totalIsolate`. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `logLevel` | `String` | `info` | `LoggerConfig.level`. |
| `CACHE_STORE` | `cacheStore` | `String` | `file` | `CacheConfig.defaultStore`: `memory`, `file` or `redis`. |
| `STORAGE_DISK` | `storageDisk` | `String` | `local` | `StorageConfig.defaultDisk`: `local`, `s3` or `memory`. |
| `DB_CONNECTION` | `dbConnection` | `String` | `sqlite` | `DatabaseConfig.connection`: `sqlite`, `postgres` or `mysql`. |
| `DB_NAME` | `dbName` | `String` | `db/dox.sqlite` | The database name. For SQLite: the file path. |
| `DB_HOST` | `dbHost` | `String` | `localhost` | Database host. |
| `DB_PORT` | `dbPort` | `int?` | not set: `5432` for Postgres, `3306` for MySQL | Database port. |
| `DB_USERNAME` | `dbUsername` | `String` | `postgres` | Database user. |
| `DB_PASSWORD` | `dbPassword` | `String` | empty | Database password. |

To add a key, add a getter to `AppEnv` and run `dart run build_runner build`. See [Environments](../guides/environments.md#2-add-a-key).

The `.env.example` of a new project:

```ini title=".env.example"
APP_NAME=dox
APP_ENV=development
APP_PORT=3000
APP_KEY=

CACHE_STORE=file
STORAGE_DISK=local

# SQLite needs no setup. The file is created at the first start.
DB_CONNECTION=sqlite
DB_NAME=db/dox.sqlite

# Postgres or MySQL: set DB_CONNECTION=postgres or mysql and fill these in.
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=5432
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_PASSWORD=postgres
```

## How `.env` is parsed

`Env.parse()` in `packages/dox-core/lib/env/env.dart`:

- One `KEY=value` per line. The key is trimmed. A line that starts with `#` is a comment.
- The value is everything after the first `=`. A second `=` is kept.
- `#` after a space starts a comment: `KEY=abc # note` gives `abc`. `KEY=abc#def` stays `abc#def`.
- A value in quotes (`"`, `'` or `` ` ``) is kept as it is, also a `#`. The quotes are removed.
- An empty value, or the text `null`, counts as missing.
- The file is read once per isolate, from the current working directory.

`dox_migration` has its own simpler parser. It removes every quote character and does not strip `# note` comments. Keep comments on their own line.
